business_summary: POSCO Holdings is a Korean steel and materials group that discloses recovering nickel, lithium carbonate, cobalt and manganese from black mass ('black matter') at its battery-material recycling operations, and states plans to expand this recycling business capacity, per its own July 2026 investor presentation. FY2024 group revenue was KRW 73.46 trillion, the largest revenue base in this batch by a wide margin.
